text:
tara: Heads up 8: NorthBridge support just escalated an invoice mismatch. Their April invoice (INV-2026-0405) shows ~1.92M embed units billed but their internal meter shows ~2.45M. They want an amendment/adjustment. Can someone run a recount?

marcus: Can you share the customer export id? Also curious whether this is undercount (we missed events) vs a client-side filter (they dropped some logs).

tara: Export id: nbx-export-20260405-07. They say they used our hosted ingestion path via the thirdparty connector (vendor: pipelinex v2.0.3). Support says connector had an incident on 2026-04-04 03:10-03:40 UTC where it returned 504 to pipeline clients.

ops-bot: Alert: pipelinex connector reported 504 spikes during 2026-04-04 03:09:58 - 2026-04-04 03:41:12 UTC. Affected shards: s-12, s-13. See incident ref PX-1487.

marcus: That window could explain lost ack events. Our metering counts on ConfirmWrite ACKs from write-coordinator; if the connector swallowed ack responses before they reached the client, the client might have retried and we deduped, or worse, we never recorded the final persisted flag.

elaine: Important for finance: if we undercounted, we should amend the invoice and issue a supplemental charge. Need legal approval for billing changes post-invoice. Tagging @finance-bot for process.

marcus: I'll run an hourly recount of embed_ingest_events and compare persisted vs exported_ledger for that customer for the 03:00-05:00 UTC window. SQL planned:

```
SELECT hour_ts, count(*) AS ingest_events, sum(persisted_flag::int) AS persisted
FROM embed_ingest_events
WHERE customer_id='northbridge' AND hour_ts BETWEEN '2026-04-04 03:00' AND '2026-04-04 05:00'
GROUP BY hour_ts ORDER BY hour_ts;
```

ops-bot: Also check `connector_delivery_failures` for pipelinex and `write_coord_ack_drops` metrics. There is a short gap in `write_coord_ack_drops` at 03:12 UTC.

marcus: Recount running (job recount-1812351111-01). ETA 15m.

finance-bot: Reminder: any supplemental invoice requires documented customer acknowledgement and legal sign-off. Please prepare a short memo with counts, timestamps, and rationale.

(twenty minutes later)

marcus: Recount results summary:
- ledger_exported_units: 1,920,412
- ingest_persisted_units: 2,448,997
- delta: +528,585 units (underbilled)
- top affected hour: 2026-04-04 03:00-04:00 UTC -> delta +412,112 units

marcus: Root cause signals: pipelinex returned 504s causing the connector to retry. A bug in pipelinex v2.0.3 caused it to ack ingestion without forwarding final confirmation, resulting in our exported ledger missing the persisted flag for many records. Those records appear in embed_ingest_events but were not marked as exported to the billing ledger.

elaine: Thanks. Marcus, please include a sample of 10 event ids that were persisted but not present in the ledger export and the corresponding connector logs so we can produce an audit packet for Legal.

marcus: Attached sample ids and logs in secure-share: https://files.redwood.internal/northbridge/recount-1812351111-sample.csv. Also opened Ops ticket PX-1491 to track vendor fix and connector roll.

tara: Proposed next steps:
1) Ops: run a controlled ledger backfill to add missing persisted rows to the billing export for the affected export id. Backfill should write an audit entry noting the source (recount job id) and justification.
2) Finance: prepare supplemental invoice for 528,585 embed units at NorthBridge's effective rate; include pro forma breakdown and emailed notice.
3) Legal: add a short statement confirming contract allows post-invoice charge for unbilled usage in the same month.
4) Engineering: work with pipelinex to release v2.0.4 patch; add server-side hedging to surface ack status reliably.

finance-bot: Action required: attach the recount output CSV and ops runbook to ticket FIN-ADJ-2026-042 for approval queue. Note that finance may request customer confirmation before applying charges.

elain??: (typo)

elaine: I'll draft the memo and route to Legal + Finance. Also recommend offering the customer a one-time grace period option to dispute the supplemental charge; good for retention. I'll cc account exec.

marcus: Ops backfill runbook in PX-1491 has rollback steps and ledger-check queries. I'll paste the runbook into the ticket shortly. Backfill risk: high if we double-apply; we'll run a dry-run to validate counts first.

tara: Great. Once Legal signs off, finance can issue the supplemental invoice. Keep customer comms transparent: include sample IDs + explanation of connector incident and the remediation plan.

finance-bot: FIN-ADJ-2026-042 created and awaiting attachments.

elaine: Thanks everyone. Leaving customer on hold and will update after approvals. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
